author: coder-sonnet
message: Fixed FIX-002 (Claude runner blocked by interactive permission sandbox). File touched: tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs only. Root cause confirmed: launchExecution() spawn args for the claude runner (~line 398-406) omitted any non-interactive permission flag, so background-spawned Write/Edit tool calls were rejected with "you haven't granted it yet" (evidence: logs/INF-001-2026-07-18T03-30-00-012Z.log result event, Write to Schema.gs rejected, zero files created). Fix: appended literal args '--permission-mode', 'acceptEdits' to the existing claude spawn args array only (codex branch untouched); kept spawn as an argument array with shell:false, no shell interpolation; explicitly avoided --dangerously-skip-permissions per ticket scope since it would also grant unrestricted Bash. Verified: node --check tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs passed. Server restart required and performed: killed existing dashboard process on port 4570 (old pid 38144), relaunched via nohup node tools/roadmap-dashboard/server.mjs (new pid 38713), confirmed curl 200 on http://127.0.0.1:4570/. Functional re-test: POST /api/execute {ticket:INF-001, runner:claude, model:claude-sonnet-5} launched a new claude subprocess (pid 38725) whose ps argv includes --permission-mode acceptEdits; new log logs/INF-001-2026-07-18T03-35-23-281Z.log shows a Write tool_use targeting src/gas/setup/schema.gs with tool_result "File created successfully at: .../src/gas/setup/schema.gs" (not a permission-denial), and the file is confirmed present on disk (4004 bytes) -- the same file path that was rejected in the pre-fix log. One unrelated Bash tool_result in the new run shows "sed command requires approval (contains potentially dangerous operations)" -- expected, since acceptEdits only auto-accepts Write/Edit and Bash remains separately gated per the ticket's own acceptance criteria. Did not wait for INF-001 to reach a terminal ledger state; not required by FIX-002 acceptance criteria (evidence of accepted write calls is sufficient). roadmap.md not touched.
